text:

*The fillings are done very well, the dentist is gentle, and the assistants are very cooperative. I've encountered some places that don't suction saliva properly, letting it drip down to my neck, lol.
*The tartar removal is also very thorough, cleaning every nook and cranny, especially where there's a lot of tartar, until it's spotless.
The X-ray equipment is new and clean.
I highly recommend it. Make an appointment in advance because the schedule is very busy.
